summary: Full end-to-end testing of the new 3-level hierarchical category feature (backend CRUD + depth limit + frontend drill-down + admin management + product cascading path selector). 15/15 backend tests pass. Frontend home, header, drill-down, admin category tree and cascading product form all render and function correctly.

issues: Sub-menu items in the header multi-level dropdown are not exposed via data-testid (spec mentioned category-nav-{id} for mains — sub / sub-sub items have no distinguishing testid, making automated testing of the flyout harder). The dropdown itself works visually (Douleur & Fièvre / Digestion shown on hover).

action_items: (Optional / low priority) Add data-testid attributes to the header sub and sub-sub dropdown links, e.g. category-nav-sub-{id} and category-nav-leaf-{id}, to enable robust automated testing of the multi-level flyout.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1364 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, catalog, orders, admin) for maintainability (>700 lines guideline).

delete_category cascades correctly and nullifies category_id on affected products (good). Consider also nullifying category_id when only descendant leaves are deleted individually (currently handled because cascade always covers descendants of the deleted node).

list_products treats category_id as a plain string equality; only leaf-scoped filtering works (which matches the drill-down design — mains/subs show child cards, not products, so no cross-level product listing is needed).
CategoryInput.parent_id is trusted directly from client on PUT is ignored (only label/icon/image/order updated) — good, prevents accidental re-parenting bypassing depth check.

The `ensure_category_tree()` migration wipes db.products + db.categories the first time — safe because gated by meta flag cat_tree_v1, but destructive if flag ever gets dropped. Consider guarding with an env flag as well.
seed_data_creation: None persisted — all TEST_* categories/products created during CRUD tests were deleted (cascade delete + explicit product delete).
context_for_next_testing_agent: 3-level category tree feature is fully working. Backend endpoints: GET /api/categories (13 top-level, nested tree), GET /api/categories/{id} (ancestors+children), POST/PUT/DELETE /api/categories (admin, MAX_LEVEL=2 enforced -> HTTP 400 on 4th level, delete cascades to descendants and nullifies product category_id). Products filterable by category_id (leaf). Frontend: Home shows 13 category cards (data-testid home-category-*), Header has 13 data-testid category-nav-* with hover multi-level dropdown (sub items lack data-testid — minor), Catalog drill-down at /categorie/{id} renders child-cards for non-leaf and products for leaf with breadcrumb. Admin /admin: 13 root category rows with expand/add-child/edit/delete and cascading product form (pf-cat-level-0/1/2 populate correctly: 13 mains -> 2 subs -> 2 leaves). Total 104 products.
